A [[Blood/Legends|bloody]]<ref name="GH07">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 07: The First Spaceflights}}</ref> '''civil war''' was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="GH05" /> during the [[Pre-Republic era]]. With the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Sith King|King]] [[Adas]], the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] were sent into disarray and battled each other with many claiming the title of ''[[Sith'ari/Legends|Sith'ari]]'' in their attempts to capitalize upon the power vacuum left in Adas's absence. As a result of the war, the Sith [[Capital/Legends|capital]] was relocated to [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="END" />
